ns2:section.sectionText: Meets with Linguistics 199, 52723. Topic is Modern Greek Culture, Politics, and History. Interdisciplinary course, designed for students interested in politics, history, language and culture. Focus on major developments in Greece and Cyprus during 20th century, their effect on Greek identity, and how they illustrate more general trends in Europe and the Balkans. Topics include: the Language Question, the Greek Civil War, European Union membership, Turkey-Greece-Cyprus relations. Discussion-based. Reading materials include novels, politics and history texts. Knowledge of Modern Greek not required. 3 credit hours.
